reason: Adds a DeepSeek Harness web interface for recent-file listings, local previews of text, images, PDFs, and Office documents, plus actions to open files or reveal them in their containing folders.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 网页端提供会话文件列表、文本与常见文档预览，以及打开文件和定位所在文件夹的操作。
summaries.en: Adds session file listings, previews for text and common document formats, and actions to open files or reveal them in their containing folders in the DeepSeek Harness web interface.

capabilities: Reads local files for preview and serves selected content to the local web interface
Registers loopback-only HTTP endpoints for file preview, opening, and revealing files
Launches the operating system default program or file manager for a specified absolute path
Installs plugin files and updates the DeepSeek Harness web profile patch configuration
